## Type

## For list additions

- [ ] Each entry is **freely usable** (open source, open access, or a usable free tier — tagged `commercial-free-tier` if so)
- [ ] Each project is **maintained** (activity in ~2 years) or is a complete artefact that doesn't need maintenance
- [ ] Entries are in the **right section**, in **alphabetical order** within it
- [ ] Format matches the list: `- [Name](url) — one-sentence description. \`tag\``
- [ ] Descriptions are **my own words**, not copied from the project's website
- [ ] Links are canonical (no tracking parameters, no shorteners) and I clicked every one
- [ ] Not already listed elsewhere in the same list

**Are you affiliated with anything you added?** <!-- "No" / "Yes, I maintain X" — both fine -->

## For templates

- [ ] Runs end-to-end with only the dependencies named in the file header
- [ ] Units are explicit in variable names or comments
- [ ] Comments explain the **engineering**, not the syntax
- [ ] Numbers are physically plausible
- [ ] Header block present: purpose, author, licence, dependencies, what to change first
- [ ] Added to the table in `templates/README.md`
- [ ] Notebook outputs cleared (unless rendered output is the point — say so below)

## For workflows

- [ ] Dependencies pinned to versions (`environment.yaml` / Docker tag, never `latest`)
- [ ] Includes a test case that runs in under a minute
- [ ] Runtime, memory, and any GPU/cluster requirement documented
- [ ] Method assumptions and validity limits stated in the README
- [ ] No credentials, licensed binaries, or institutional paths committed
